## What is Audit Policy

Audit Policy is a YAML file that defines which events the API server should record.
When a request occurs, Kubernetes checks it against the rules in the file.
The **first matching rule** determines the logging level.

## Policy structure

[Kubernetes documentation](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/debug/debug-cluster/audit/#audit-policy)
[Policy resource field structure](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/config-api/apiserver-audit.v1/#audit-k8s-io-v1-PolicyRule)

In Kubernetes, an audit policy is defined as a YAML file and consists of a set of rules that determine which events are logged and at what level of detail.
The file has the following structure:

```yaml
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1  # API version used for the audit policy
kind: Policy                 # Resource type — always Policy
rules:                       # Set of audit rules
  - level:                     # Log detail level. Required field
    users:                     # List of users whose actions are logged
    userGroups:                # User groups (for example, system:serviceaccounts)
    verbs:                     # Logged actions/operations (create, update, delete, etc.)
    resources:                 # Kubernetes resources this rule applies to
    namespaces:                # Namespaces covered by this rule
```

The `rules` array defines audit rules.
Each rule contains the following fields:

- `level` — the level of detail for logged events.
  Possible values (from most detailed to least detailed):
  - `None` — do not log,
  - `Metadata` — only request metadata (who, when, what, from where; without object content),
  - `Request` — also stores the request body (for write operations),
  - `RequestResponse` — stores both request and response bodies.

- `users` — a list of user names the rule applies to (for example, `["admin"]`).
If these are service accounts, the name usually looks like `system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:<serviceaccount-name>`.
For regular users, the name depends on the authentication system configuration.
For `deckhouse.io/v1` objects, `Users` uses `email` as the name.

- `userGroups` — user groups (for example, `["system:authenticated"]`).
After authentication, kube-apiserver assigns each user a list of groups (for example, all authenticated users are part of `system:authenticated`, service accounts belong to additional groups).
If a request comes from a user who belongs to at least one group listed in `userGroups`, the rule is applied to that request.

  Built-in Kubernetes groups:
  - `system:authenticated` — all authenticated users.
  - `system:unauthenticated` — requests from anonymous users.
  - `system:serviceaccounts` — all service accounts in all namespaces.
  - `system:serviceaccounts:<namespace>` — service accounts in a specific namespace.

- `verbs` — list of API operations (`get`, `list`, `create`, `delete`, etc.).

- `resources` — array of target resources:
  - `group` — API group (for example, `"apps"`, `"batch"`, `""` for core),
  - `resources` — resource kinds (for example, `["pods", "deployments"]`). You can get the full list of resources and groups with `kubectl api-resources`.

- `namespaces` — array of namespaces where the rule applies.

- `nonResourceURLs` —— set of URL paths to audit. The `*` symbol is allowed only as a full, final path segment. Examples:
  - `/metrics` — log requests to apiserver metrics,
  - `/healthz*` — log all health check requests.

## Built-in audit rules

Deckhouse Platform (DP) deploys a basic audit policy by default, which can be extended with user-defined rules.

The policy implements the following rules:

{% offtopic title="Do not log health probes (<code>/readyz</code>, <code>/livez</code>, <code>/healthz</code>). This rule does not apply to requests that fail authentication." %}

```yaml
level: None
userGroups:
  - system:authenticated
  - system:unauthenticated
nonResourceURLs:
  - /readyz
  - /readyz/*
  - /livez
  - /livez/*
  - /healthz
  - /healthz/*
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log frequent updates for <code>Endpoints</code>, <code>EndpointSlices</code>, and <code>Events</code>." %}

```yaml
level: None
resources:
  - resources:
      - endpoints
      - endpointslices
      - events
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log leader election operations on <code>Lease</code> resources." %}

```yaml
level: None
resources:
  - group: coordination.k8s.io
    resources:
      - leases
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log cert-manager leader election ConfigMaps." %}

```yaml
level: None
resources:
  - resources:
      - configmaps
    resourceNames:
      - cert-manager-cainjector-leader-election
      - cert-manager-controller
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpoints resources." %}

```yaml
level: None
resources:
  - group: autoscaling.k8s.io
    resources:
      - verticalpodautoscalercheckpoints
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log PATCH operations on <code>VerticalPodAutoscaler</code> from recommender." %}

```yaml
level: None
users:
  - system:serviceaccount:kube-system:d8-vertical-pod-autoscaler-recommender
verbs:
  - patch
resources:
  - group: autoscaling.k8s.io
    resources:
      - verticalpodautoscalers
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log UpmeterHookProbes resources." %}

```yaml
level: None
resources:
  - group: deckhouse.io
    resources:
      - upmeterhookprobes
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log any operations in <code>d8-upmeter</code> namespace." %}

```yaml
level: None
namespaces:
  - d8-upmeter
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log ingress-nginx leader election updates in ConfigMaps." %}

```yaml
level: None
users:
  - system:serviceaccount:d8-ingress-nginx:ingress-nginx
verbs:
  - update
resources:
  - resources:
      - configmaps
namespaces:
  - d8-ingress-nginx
```

{% endofftopic %}

{% offtopic title="Do not log dex health-check create/delete operations on <code>AuthRequest</code> resources." %}

```yaml
level: None
users:
  - system:serviceaccount:d8-user-authn:dex
verbs:
  - create
  - delete
resources:
  - group: dex.coreos.com
    resources:
      - authrequests
namespaces:

```

{% offtopic title="Log create and delete operations for Node resources with request/response payload." %}

```yaml
  - delete
resources:

```

## Full policy example

```yaml
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1
kind: Policy
rules:
  # 1: Do not log health probes (`/readyz`, `/livez`, `/healthz`). This rule does not apply to requests that fail authentication.
  - level: None
    userGroups:
      - system:authenticated
      - system:unauthenticated
    nonResourceURLs:
      - /readyz
      - /readyz/*
      - /livez
      - /livez/*
      - /healthz
      - /healthz/*

  # 2: Do not log frequent updates for `Endpoints`, `EndpointSlices`, and `Events`.
  - level: None
    resources:
      - resources:
          - endpoints
          - endpointslices
          - events

  # 3: Do not log leader election operations on `Lease` resources.
  - level: None
    resources:
      - group: coordination.k8s.io
        resources:
          - leases

  # 4: Do not log cert-manager leader election ConfigMaps.
  - level: None
    resources:
      - resources:
          - configmaps
        resourceNames:
          - cert-manager-cainjector-leader-election
          - cert-manager-controller

  # 5: Do not log VerticalPodAutoscalerCheckpoints resources.
  - level: None
    resources:
      - group: autoscaling.k8s.io
        resources:
          - verticalpodautoscalercheckpoints

  # 6: Do not log PATCH operations on `VerticalPodAutoscaler` from recommender.
  - level: None
    users:
      - system:serviceaccount:kube-system:d8-vertical-pod-autoscaler-recommender
    verbs:
      - patch
    resources:
      - group: autoscaling.k8s.io
        resources:
          - verticalpodautoscalers

  # 7: Do not log UpmeterHookProbes resources.
  - level: None
    resources:
      - group: deckhouse.io
        resources:
          - upmeterhookprobes

  # 8: Do not log any operations in `d8-upmeter` namespace.
  - level: None
    namespaces:
      - d8-upmeter

  # 9: Do not log ingress-nginx leader election updates in ConfigMaps.
  - level: None
    users:
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-ingress-nginx:ingress-nginx
    verbs:
      - update
    resources:
      - resources:
          - configmaps
    namespaces:
      - d8-ingress-nginx

  # 10: Do not log dex health-check create/delete operations on `AuthRequest` resources.
  - level: None
    users:
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-user-authn:dex
    verbs:
      - create
      - delete
    resources:
      - group: dex.coreos.com
        resources:
          - authrequests
    namespaces:
      - d8-user-authn

  # 11: Log create and delete operations for Node resources with request/response payload.
  - level: RequestResponse
    verbs:
      - create
      - delete
    resources:
      - resources:
          - nodes

  # 12: Log kubectl logs requests (pods/log) at Metadata level.
  - level: Metadata
    resources:
      - resources:
          - pods/log

  # 13: Log create/update/patch/delete operations from system service accounts (`kube-system`, `d8-*`).
  - level: Metadata
    users:
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cert-manager:cainjector
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cert-manager:cert-manager
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cert-manager:webhook
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cert-manager:yandex-dns-webhook
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-chrony:chrony-exporter
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-chrony:chrony-exporter-master
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:caps-controller-manager
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:cluster-autoscaler
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:fencing-agent
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:integrity-containerd-configurator
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:integrity-controller
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:machine-controller-manager
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:node-controller
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:node-feature-discovery-gc
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:node-feature-discovery-master
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:node-feature-discovery-worker
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:node-group
      - system:serviceaccount:d8-cloud-instance-manager:node-group-exporter

  # 14: Log create/update/patch/delete operations for Pod resources.
  - level: Request
    verbs:
      - create
      - delete
      - patch
      - update
    resources:
      - resources:
          - pods
    omitStages:
      - RequestReceived

  # 15: Log Pod status updates from kubelet (pods/status) with the request body to capture container terminations and their reasons.
  - level: Request
    userGroups:
      - system:nodes
    verbs:
      - patch
      - update
    resources:
      - resources:
          - pods/status
    omitStages:
      - RequestReceived

  # 16: Log create/update/patch/delete operations in system namespaces (`kube-system`, `d8-*`).
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - create
      - update
      - patch
      - delete
    namespaces:
      - d8-admission-policy-engine
      - d8-cert-manager
      - d8-chrony
      - d8-cloud-instance-manager
      - d8-cloud-provider-aws
      - d8-cloud-provider-azure
      - d8-cloud-provider-dvp
      - d8-cloud-provider-dynamix
      - d8-cloud-provider-gcp
      - d8-cloud-provider-huaweicloud
      - d8-cloud-provider-openstack
      - d8-cloud-provider-vcd
      - d8-cloud-provider-vsphere

      - d8-cloud-provider-zvirt
      - d8-cni-cilium
      - d8-cni-flannel
      - d8-cni-simple-bridge
      - d8-csi-vsphere
      - d8-descheduler
      - d8-istio

      - d8-local-path-provisioner

      - d8-okmeter
      - d8-openvpn
      - d8-system
      - d8-user-authn
      - d8-user-authz
      - kube-system
    omitStages:
      - RequestReceived

  # 17: Log all LIST operations in all namespaces.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - list

  # 18: Log create and delete operations for ServiceAccount resources.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - create
      - delete
    resources:
      - resources:
          - serviceaccounts
    omitStages:
      - RequestReceived

  # 19: Log create/update/delete/patch operations for Role and ClusterRole resources.
  - level: Request
    verbs:
      - create
      - update
      - delete
      - patch
    resources:
      - group: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
        resources:
          - roles
          - clusterroles
    omitStages:
      - RequestReceived

  # 20: Log create/update/delete operations for ClusterRoleBinding resources.
  - level: Request
    verbs:
      - create
      - update
      - delete
    resources:
      - group: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
        resources:
          - clusterrolebindings
    omitStages:
      - RequestReceived

  # 21: Log exec, attach and ephemeral container related pod subresource operations.
  - level: Request
    verbs:
      - get
      - patch
      - create
    resources:
      - resources:
          - pods/exec
          - pods/attach
          - pods/ephemeralcontainers
    omitStages:
      - RequestReceived

  # 22: Log creation of VirtualMachineOperation resources with request/response payload.
  - level: RequestResponse
    verbs:
      - create
    resources:
      - group: virtualization.deckhouse.io
        resources:
          - virtualmachineoperations

  # 23: Log create/update/patch/delete operations for virtualization.deckhouse.io resources.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - create
      - update
      - patch
      - delete
    resources:
      - group: virtualization.deckhouse.io

  # 24: Log update/patch operations for internal virtualization subresources.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - update
      - patch
    resources:
      - group: internal.virtualization.deckhouse.io
        resources:
          - internalvirtualizationvirtualmachineinstances

  # 25: Log GET operations for subresources.virtualization.deckhouse.io API group.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - get
    resources:
      - group: subresources.virtualization.deckhouse.io

  # 26: Log create/update/patch/delete operations for `Pod` resources.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - create
      - update
      - patch
      - delete
    resources:
      - resources:
          - pods

  # 27: Log create/update/patch/delete operations in `d8-virtualization` namespace.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - create
      - update
      - patch
      - delete
    namespaces:
      - d8-virtualization

  # 28: Log create/update/patch/delete operations for ModuleConfig resources.
  - level: Metadata
    verbs:
      - create
      - update
      - patch
      - delete
    resources:
      - group: deckhouse.io
        resources:
          - moduleconfigs

  ############
  # User-defined rules from secret kube-system/audit-policy are inserted here
  ############
  # 29: Do not log requests from authenticated users.
  - level: None
    userGroups:
      - system:authenticated

  # 30: Log all remaining (unauthenticated) requests at Metadata level.
  - level: Metadata
```
